Class SshClientTheme.QuietOcean

java.lang.Object
javax.swing.plaf.metal.MetalTheme
javax.swing.plaf.metal.DefaultMetalTheme
javax.swing.plaf.metal.OceanTheme
org.casserole.app.ui.ssh.SshClientTheme.QuietOcean
Enclosing class:
SshClientTheme
private static final class SshClientTheme.QuietOcean extends OceanTheme
The QuietOcean theme keeps Metal and replaces the light edges. The secondary colors and the white color become the bevel highlight. Disabled menu text uses the inactive control text color. Disabled control color uses that same inactive text color.
